title: Retaining walls and fill behind the street setback: setback per Table 3.5a
text: Retaining walls and fill within the site and behind the street setback to comply with Table 3.5a.

replaces.note: Part B Table 4: 0.5 m at nil setback -> 1 m at nil setback

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Same as Chapter 2 C3.5.2. Height is measured from NGL at the lot boundary adjacent to that point of the wall (Table 3.5a note). Part C (R30+) already had these values; R25 and below: nil setback up to 1 m (was 0.5 m).
